prediction.experiment_decision: Require a comparison against a baseline with the same number of epochs but different hyperparameters (e.g., learning rate) or a different model architecture to rule out overfitting or data leakage. Additionally, verify that the validation set is truly held-out and not part of the training data.
prediction.reason: Lower validation error with more epochs can indicate overfitting if the model is memorizing the validation set, or it could be a result of data leakage. A proper control experiment is needed to ensure that the improvement is due to the increased training time and not an artifact of the experimental setup.
